title: One index-file version bump for alignment and the parts file, or two?
body:
Padding the header for alignment (sail-bb932e) and adding the parts file (sail-a59d6f) both change what sits on disk.

1. One bump: land both as `VERSION = 2`. One older layout to keep reading.
2. Two bumps: each lands on its own. Two older layouts to read for as long as the format exists.

Lean: the question dissolves if sail-9d931d goes by reference. The parts file is then its own file with its own magic and version. The `.saidx` layout changes once, for alignment.
close_reason: Dissolved by sail-9d931d going by reference. The parts file is its own file with its own magic and version, so .saidx changes once, for alignment (sail-bb932e).
